def transform(grid):
    # Move the patterned object from below the horizontal divider to above it,
    # placing it immediately adjacent to the divider; divider shifts to object color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    divider = next((i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == row[0] for v in row) and row[0] != bg), None)
    if divider is None: return out
    dcol = grid[divider][0]
    # find non-background component below line
    coords = [(r,c) for r in range(divider+1,h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    if not coords: return out
    color = grid[coords[0][0]][coords[0][1]]
    # bounding box of object
    r0=min(r for r,c in coords); r1=max(r for r,c in coords); c0=min(c for r,c in coords); c1=max(c for r,c in coords)
    obj=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # restore source then place directly above divider, divider recolored to 8
    for r,c in coords: out[r][c]=bg
    top=divider-len(obj)
    if top<0: top=0
    for i,row in enumerate(obj):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v != bg: out[top+i][c0+j]=v
    out[divider]=[8]*w
    return out
PY
